resources.string: Touch: two sticks + skill fan (D2R Mobile style)
Touch: quick-access buttons on the sides

Both touch layouts: the move stick appears under your left thumb in the lower left, the aim stick (right stick) under your right thumb anywhere free in the lower right. Fan: A primary, B X Y R around it, ZR above, II = second skill set (holds the modifier while a skill is used); bottom row = d-pad and +, top = ZL L L3, − R3. Side layout: every Switch button as its own cell: right edge A B X Y R ZR and modifier + each of them, left edge L ZL and the d-pad, top L3 − + R3. Menus are driven with the buttons (the game has no touch of its own).
Makes the hero walk (and aim) the way the finger points. Push the stick at 45 degrees: if the hero walks flatter than the finger, raise it.
Second skill set modifier (II / the inner side column)
The button the game holds for its second set of skills; it goes down a moment before the skill button.
Tap on the world (outside the sticks)
Turn toward the point, then A
Touch and hold the world = walk toward the finger
Dragging a fan skill aims with
